title: Deke Sar Shabbir Ne
body:
Deke Sar Shabbir Ne
(Ya Hussein) x4
<<MINI>>
(Deke sar shabbir ne, islaam zindaa kardiya) x3
(Karbala ko jiske sajde) x2 ne mu-alla kardiya
(Deke sar shabbir ne, islaam zindaa kardiya) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Hashr tak koi yazidi sar utha sakta nahi, jiska badla zindagi bhar deen jukaa sakta nahi, (fatema ke laal ne) x2 ehsaan aisa kardiya
<<MINI>>
(Deke sar shabbir ne, islaam zindaa kardiya) x2
Karbala ko jiske sajde, ne mu-alla kardiya
(Deke sar shabbir ne, islaam zindaa kardiya) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Teri qurbani se pehle deen ko aaya na chain, ambiya se bhi mukammil jo naho paaya hussein, (ek sajde ne tere woh) x2 kaam pura kardiya
<<MINI>>
(Deke sar shabbir ne, islaam zindaa kardiya) x2
Karbala ko jiske sajde, ne mu-alla kardiya
(Deke sar shabbir ne, islaam zindaa kardiya) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Aaj bhi naagaah wafaaen hai tere abbas par, nehr par ghazi ke dono kat gaye baazu magar, (taa abad islaam ke) x2 parcham ko uncha kardiya
<<MINI>>
(Deke sar shabbir ne, islaam zindaa kardiya) x2
Karbala ko jiske sajde, ne mu-alla kardiya
(Deke sar shabbir ne, islaam zindaa kardiya) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Maar kar ibne ali ko cheeni zainab ki ridaa, jab parha kalma nabi kaa phir sare karbobala, (aale ehmad ke liye) x2
yu(n) hashr barpaa kardiya
<<MINI>>
(Deke sar shabbir ne, islaam zindaa kardiya) x2
Karbala ko jiske sajde, ne mu-alla kardiya
(Deke sar shabbir ne, islaam zindaa kardiya) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Naazon se noke sinaa pe ubhraa thaa ""Jawaad"" jo, kaise bhulegaa zamana fatema ke chaand ko, (sar kataake usne apna) x2
yu(n) ujaala kardiya
<<MINI>>
(Deke sar shabbir ne, islaam zindaa kardiya) x2
Karbala ko jiske sajde, ne mu-alla kardiya
(Deke sar shabbir ne, islaam zindaa kardiya) x2
